description: This source file generates a catalog of official channels by inspecting extension directories within a project, reading their package.json files, and selecting those that meet specific criteria. It can produce and write the catalog JSON to a specified location.

methods.name: isRecord
methods.description: Checks if the input value is a non-null object that is not an array.

methods.name: trimString
methods.description: Trims whitespace from a string, returning an empty string if the input is not a string.

methods.name: toCatalogInstall
methods.description: Normalizes installation info from a package manifest, considering default choices and npm specifications.

methods.name: buildCatalogEntry
methods.description: Creates a catalog entry object from a package.json, based on specific openclaw manifest criteria.

methods.name: buildOfficialChannelCatalog
methods.description: Builds a catalog of extension packages by scanning directories, reading package.json files, and filtering based on manifest properties.

methods.name: writeOfficialChannelCatalog
methods.description: Generates and writes the official channel catalog JSON file to a predefined location.
